subject: SOC 2 Type II: request for report, bridge letter, and evidence transfer
messages:
From: Elena Martin <elena@pilotanalytics.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Apr 2025 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request and audit period clarification

Hi Grace,

We're preparing our vendor assurance file for an upcoming procurement review and need Redwood's SOC 2 Type II materials. Can you provide the most recent Type II report you have available and confirm the audit period covered? Our audit window runs Jan 1, 2024 - Dec 31, 2024, and audit teams sometimes ask for a bridge letter if the report's testing period doesn't fully overlap.

A couple of quick asks so we can scope internal review:
- PDF copy of the SOC 2 Type II report (redacted if necessary)
- Bridge letter if the covered period ends before 2024-12-31 or notes any scope gaps
- A short list of evidence/artifact samples you can share (e.g., log retention snapshot, access review sample, policy excerpt)
- Preferred secure transfer options and expected timeline (we aim to complete vendor review by May 1)

If there's an internal contact for procurement/escalation, please loop them in. Happy to sign an NDA if required.

Thanks,
Elena Martin
Senior Security Analyst
Pilot Analytics
security@pilotanalytics.com

[attachment: n/a]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martin <elena@pilotanalytics.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Apr 2025 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request and audit period clarification

Hi Elena — thanks for the note. Happy to help. Below is what we can share right away and a couple of quick one-line responses you can use with internal stakeholders.

What we can provide (minimal, low-friction package):
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) covering our audited period. Current available report: testing period 2024-04-01 -> 2025-03-31.
- Bridge letter that explains the covered period and confirms there were no material changes to controls between the testing period end and your audit window (we can provide a dated bridge letter if you need coverage through 2024-12-31).
- Artifact samples (redacted): log retention snapshot (last 30 days), one example access review export (user/owner redacted), retention policy excerpt (data retention and deletion), and a short system description excerpt.

Secure transfer options (pick one):
- Presigned S3 upload (preferred, short TTL)
- Secure SharePoint link with tenant-level access (if you prefer internal drives)
- Our secure portal: https://redwood-secure.example.com/upload (we can create a one-off project folder)

One-line reply snippets (pick as needed):
- "We can share our SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter; please confirm preferred secure upload method."
- "Report is available under a standard non-disclosure; do you require an NDA?"
- "We will provide redacted artifact samples (logs, access review, retention policy) via S3 presigned link within 48 hours."

Minimal redaction guidance: remove customer-identifying strings (IDs, emails) from log samples. We will provide a redacted CSV example and a short readme describing fields.

If you'd like an initial package now, say "S3" and I'll send a presigned upload URL plus a small README and attachment list.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Manager, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com

[attachment: SOC2-Sharing-Instructions.pdf (pdf) — one-page transfer+redaction checklist]

From: Elena Martin <elena@pilotanalytics.com>

Date: Sun, 20 Apr 2025 13:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request and audit period clarification

Grace — thanks, S3 works for us. Can you also confirm whether Pilot Analytics needs to execute an NDA before you upload? If not, we'll proceed on your upload link and pull the artifacts.

Also, as a heads-up for the audit team: we will only request a handful of redacted samples (no raw activity data) — log samples and one access review export.

Cheers,
Elena
